# CI-esta

> CI-esta measures GitHub Actions runs (job and step timings, runner usage, the dependency critical path to the required check) and provides public actions to shorten them safely: validated uv environment caching, packing short matrix jobs onto fewer runners, duration-balanced test shards with completion checks, strict aggregate gates and optional reuse of completed work. It works for any application language; reporting reads completed runs as data and needs no hosted service.

To set CI-esta up in a repository with a coding agent, give the agent this one prompt: "Set up CI-esta in this repository. Fetch https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-setup.md and follow it." The agent measures a completed run, makes one change and proves it; merging, required checks and repository settings stay with a person.

## Set it up

- [Agent setup procedure (raw Markdown)](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-setup.md): the complete, self-contained procedure a coding agent follows to measure CI, make one verified improvement and open a pull request
- [Quickstart](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/quickstart/): the reporting observer and environment cache by hand
- [Measure your CI critical path](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/tutorials/measure-critical-path/): read one completed run with the CLI
- [GitHub Actions reference](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/actions/): every public action and the pinning policy

## Choose an optimization

- [Pack short matrix jobs onto fewer runners](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/pack-matrix-jobs/): when per-job setup dominates many short jobs (tox, nox, uv)
- [Cache Python environments](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/environment-cache/): when dependency installation dominates
- [Balance tests with timing data](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/learned-test-timings/): when one test shard dominates
- [Reuse successful job evidence](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/evidence-reuse/): when identical declared work already passed
- [Validate skipped test lanes](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/selected-gates/): aggregate gates that fail on missing, failed or skipped work

## Understand the numbers

- [Workflow reports and metrics](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/github-actions-observability/): report fields, runner seconds and cost estimates
- [Critical-path analysis](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/critical-path/): observed chain, execution path and slack
- [Report before-and-after impact](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/measured-impact/)

## Optional

- [Adoption tutorial and checklist](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/tutorials/adoption-checklist/): every capability, staged
- [Runner capacity and hang diagnostics](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/runners-and-diagnostics/)
- [Benchmarks](https://ci-esta.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/benchmarks/2026-10-22/)
